msg: Control flow of non-void function ends here!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: eb91f1d0a53.c (Linux SLAB/lockdep). Control flow alarm at line 92 for 'static int setup_cpu_cache()' having no return statement, when def(CONFIG_SLAB). The function body just calls 'kmalloc_node(GFP_KERNEL)' with no return — simplification artifact. In the real Linux kernel, setup_cpu_cache() returns an int error code. The known vbdb bug for this file is the lockdep assertion failure (assert(!irqs_disabled) at line 36 fires when GFP_KERNEL allocation is attempted after local_irq_disable()), which is unrelated to this alarm.
